about_short_description.short_description: Shalfa provides security support services to public and private organizations, as well as operational and maintenance assistance.

product.name: Security Services
product.description: Provision of security personnel and safety services to public and private organizations, including civil guard security for government headquarters and municipalities.

product.name: Operation and Maintenance
product.description: Management and execution of operational and maintenance programs to ensure cost-effective facility functionality and longevity.

product.name: Facility Management
product.description: Integrated management of multiple facility services including maintenance, cleaning, security, and waste management under a single point of contact.

product.name: Environmental Services
product.description: Handling and management of municipal and hazardous waste for public and private sector clients, including sludge and other complex waste types.

product.name: Firefighting Services
product.description: Provision of firefighting support and safety services integrated within facility management and security operations.
